'''Lord Brys''' is a nobleman from [[Tarabon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Brys}}

==Activities==
Floran Gelb passes information from the body servant to Lord Brys to [[Egeanin Tamarath]] at the [[Garden of Silver Breezes]] in [[Tanchico]]. Gelb says the Assembly has secretly chosen a new Panarch.{{ref/book|4|38}}
